answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with rotating identity keys that must be re-attested every epoch. Each key expires at epoch end and can only be renewed when several genuine counterparties countersign the new key. A farm cannot clone identities freely: every fake needs its own web of real counterparties, each of whom countersigns only agents they traded with. Like an ember passed from lantern to lantern across karst, trust travels only through real contact; each extra fake must build its own fresh relationships, a cost that cannot be shared, parallelized, or bought in bulk.
